assets.usage: Personagem jogável (Dheep). Quadros: parado, esquerda, direita, comendo/feliz, derrota. Ancorado pelos pés.
assets.prompt: Redraw this character sprite sheet as a clearly ADULT man, about 25-28 years old: defined jawline, light stubble beard, adult proportions (about 4.5 heads tall, broad shoulders, slightly chubby friendly build), NOT a child. 5 full-body poses in one horizontal row, same scale, feet on the same baseline. Short dark wavy hair, big expressive happy eyes, wide smile, bright purple t-shirt, teal knee-length shorts, white casual sneakers, small orange wristband. Poses: 1) idle, hands on belly, mouth open ready to eat; 2) stepping LEFT; 3) stepping RIGHT; 4) happy eating, cheeks full, arms up celebrating; 5) defeated, stuffed and dizzy, hands on round belly, swirly eyes.
